ios.head: App Total Install +16.2% — Organic Install is behind most of it (+705, +69.9%).

ios.head: App Total Revenue -19.0% matches the new subs signed up 7 days earlier.

insights.title: Market trend — US is losing ground fast on turning installs into subs (-14.2%, now 12.4%).
